<!-- nativecmpkit-resolution:UI-033:20261027-original-acceptance -->
## Verified resolution — original UI-033 acceptance

**Root cause:** Discrete semantic snapping initialized its distance search with the negative target value, so no absolute distance could qualify.

**Repair:** A shared SliderValueDomain snaps numerically with a nonnegative normalized distance; SliderInput applies it to actual semantics and completes only a changed value. Negative ranges/ties/endpoints are handled without allocating tick arrays for input.

**Affected implementation:** [`calf-ui/src/commonMain/kotlin/com/mohamedrejeb/calf/ui/slider/SliderValueDomain.kt`](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/blob/8ab82a3fa41caad34cd7fb7a2d3722bfc25e3838/calf-ui/src/commonMain/kotlin/com/mohamedrejeb/calf/ui/slider/SliderValueDomain.kt) — SliderValueDomain.snap; SliderInput.setProgress.

### Original required checks reviewed
- **Semantic setProgress on-1..1,steps3,target-0.7 expects-0.5.** — passed-scoped-runtime. Methods: `CupertinoSliderInteractionTest.negativeSetProgressUsesDiscreteStepsAndFinishesOnce`, `SliderValueDomainTest.negativeAccessibilityTargetSnapsToNearestStep`.
- **All-negative range, zero/positive ranges, ties/endpoints and callback completion.** — passed-scoped-runtime. Methods: `SliderValueDomainTest.allNegativeRangesAndTiesUseTheSameRule`, `SliderValueDomainTest.continuousAndDiscreteEndpointsStayInRange`, `SliderValueDomainTest.zeroRangeAndZeroWidthNeverProduceNonFiniteValues`, `CupertinoSliderInteractionTest.negativeSetProgressUsesDiscreteStepsAndFinishesOnce`.

[Verbatim original-requirement/source/Git/XML review](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/blob/8ab82a3fa41caad34cd7fb7a2d3722bfc25e3838/docs/development/evidence/closure-review-20261027-001/lead-original-acceptance-review.json) at immutable evidence commit `8ab82a3fa41caad34cd7fb7a2d3722bfc25e3838`. Unchanged owning implementation/tests pass12 actual Compose slider interaction methods and8 numeric-domain methods on each Linux/macOS desktop in those immutable runs, including semantic `setProgress(-0.7) -> -0.5` with exactly one completion. 

[Current staged preflight](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/blob/8ab82a3fa41caad34cd7fb7a2d3722bfc25e3838/docs/development/evidence/ci-preflight-20261027-019/lead-review.json) passes23/23 commands,1,137 overlapping Python executions, strict documentation/actionlint and both whitespace checks; it executes zero new library/native/packaged methods.

**Compatibility / limits:** Existing public packages/signatures remain; changes are internal or additive. Original baseline audit/source probes are preserved. Executed scope is the shared Cupertino numeric/semantic implementation on desktop. Physical iOS accessibility and Liquid branch verification remain separate UI-028/029 gates, not claimed here. Original issue description, labels, upstream discussion and previous remaining notes are preserved. This closes only the original specific defect after required-scope review; minimum-platform/device/native-stack integration, whole-library API/ABI, full packaged consumers, dependency trust, legal/native-payload and all other issue/release gates remain independent and are not waived. No package, release, deployment or Pages publication.
